_comment: A pinned, unmodified copy of Learn's page 'Configure restrictions on how applications can be configured', as its source in MicrosoftDocs/entra-docs: the procedure (admin center and Microsoft Graph) for enabling app management policy restrictions tenant-wide, granting an app or a caller an exception, applying a restriction to one app and fixing the policy state for the admin center. The Graph requests exist only inside this page. Never edit these files: update the snapshot by copying a newer upstream commit and regenerating this manifest in a reviewed pull request. scripts/tests/test_third_party_snapshots.py fails when a file stops matching its hash.
